history.summary: IDENTITY UNCERTAIN - no independent web record exists for a temple specifically called 'Trimurti Temple' at Bhamaiya, near Godhra. The official Dada Bhagwan site states the Godhra Trimandir (seq 1474) stands 'near the village of Bhamaiya, opposite FCI Godown, on National Highway 59' - and 'Trimandir' (temple of three) is easily rendered as 'Trimurti Temple'. POSSIBLE DUPLICATE of seq 1474 / Godhra Trimandir. Kept as a separate placeholder row per CSV; verify with local sources before treating it as a distinct temple.

name: Trimurti Temple, Bhamaiya
town_description: Bhamaiya is a small village on the outskirts of Godhra city in Panchmahal district, Gujarat, on National Highway 59 toward Ahmedabad. It lies about 4-5 km from Godhra town and hosts roadside institutions including the FCI godown opposite which the Godhra Trimandir stands. It is essentially a peri-urban settlement serving Godhra's highway corridor.

travel.road: On National Highway 59 near Bhamaiya village, opposite the FCI godown (verify)

visitor_information.opening_hours: Unknown (identity unverified). If this is the Godhra Trimandir, Justdial lists 6:00 AM - 9:00 PM daily (verify).
